authorship_boundary: Reviewer authored sorting only. compression.py and common.py are independently reviewed; no reviewed source/test or prior author report was edited.

runs.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_acceptance_compression.py --tb=short

review_conclusions.conclusion: Cost is the actual byte length of the four-byte magic, four-byte original length and full payload. It is not just RLE payload size and not JSON hex-transport size. Default known-wire controls verify 137/12/266 bytes.

The bounded versioned decoder rejects mismatched lengths, bad HEX alphabet, malformed/zero RLE counts and trailing content; decoded bytes are compared with the original dataset. A syntactically valid measurement envelope containing a lossy or malformed container is classified invalid, not misreported as an infrastructure HOLD.

Unchecked measurement returns a normal unknown claim before invoking the roundtrip oracle. An existing direct oracle-tripwire test independently passes in this run. This review does not re-count the author's prior draft failure as a new failure.

The worker reads three distinct candidate measurements for the same dataset, verifies complete container cost and roundtrip, and emits a new analysis envelope carrying the original unchecked container. Domain interpretation checks the stated containers, results and source-ID order. Analysis does not rerun the encoder or mutate the original unknown record; it is not a statistically independent algorithm measurement.

Prepared inputs pin candidate, operation, dataset and ordered source identities. Source reads require the exact descriptor-ID set and actual raw-byte SHA-256. Claims require exact envelope fields, matching metadata, strict nonnegative integer cost and finite nonnegative timings. Comparison scope hashes the protocol fingerprint with dataset identity, not candidate identity.

dataset_sha256 hashes canonical JSON; compression represents its bytes as a JSON hex string. Worker timers start inside main before input reads and are sampled while constructing the envelope, excluding interpreter startup/imports and final JSON encoding/output. They are neither pure algorithm-only timing nor full CLI/native elapsed.

trust_boundary: The source FD bytes are provenance-bound by the existing native adapter and checked by the worker; common.py does not independently establish Core attempt/effect/SQLite authority.

Domain interpret revalidates reported container/trace evidence but does not itself re-read source FDs. Scientific source interpretation relies on the pinned trusted local worker implementation; this is not adversarial-worker containment or an OS sandbox.
The real supervised worker in the 31-case unit group reads golden sealed source fixtures, not three prior SQLite/native campaign attempts.
The finite datasets and deliberately fixed candidates do not establish universal lossless-compression, sorting correctness, candidate discovery or research-efficiency improvements.
Actual CLI/SQLite/Policy/replication/Stop campaign results and the full repository suite remain the root's separately recorded evidence.

document_review.conclusion: Read completely. The documented full-container metric, canonical-JSON dataset digest, unknown-before-oracle semantics, analysis-not-new-measurement distinction, occurrence-versus-statistical-independence limit and worker-main timing scope agree with the reviewed implementation. The document explicitly excludes interpreter startup/final JSON output from worker timing and rejects subtracting worker wall from CLI wall to claim pure framework CPU or general percentage savings.
not_independently_recomputed: The four exported product-report numeric timing rows
Native/CLI timer implementation outside these two reviewed modules
document_review.scope: This hashes the document actually read, not any subsequent edited version.

limitations: No new tests were introduced, no old assertions were changed, no holdout was read, and no GPU/provider/network or host-wide process operation was run.
